text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
No, no, it's not really something to tell people...
Hmm, but maybe I should tell Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"Actually... my weight just won't seem to drop.
Think I'm in trouble if I don't do something about it?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I wonder if you
happen to know any good ideas...?
choice_data_list: Maybe try using what you love to get some exercise?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Something I like, huh... Sounds good, but
I wonder if there's anything nice?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And the place we arrived at...
was a golf driving range.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ah, this really is the best way to refresh myself!
Plus, it's great exercise too!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
The best part is how simple it is: 1 swing burns about 1 kcal!
Super easy to calculate!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
So now, all that's left is to hit, hit, and keep on hitting!
My goal is four digits!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Come on, Trainer, forget about all the annoying stuff and just smash away! I'll even teach ya how if you want!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "—And so, the two batted and batted away like crazy, and Mejiro Palmer successfully managed to lose weight."
